statement: Average sensitivity of polynomial threshold functions. Proves that a degree-at-most-d polynomial threshold function on the uniform n-dimensional Boolean cube has average sensitivity at most $`8d\sqrt n`$, uniformly for $`1\le d\le n`$. Average sensitivity counts expected output changes under single-bit flips. This establishes the asymptotic Gotsman–Linial conjecture, allowing polynomial zeros with $`\mathop{\mathrm{sign}}\nolimits (0)=1`$.
